title: DxfImport Command
description: Forsk's DXF import: Rhino's import of the file, then every imported text rewritten from the DXF source (TEXT and MTEXT decoded once: \U+XXXX and \M+ escapes, %% codes, MTEXT formatting, $DWGCODEPAGE before AutoCAD 2007). Rhino's own import loses escapes such as \U+00F8. A text is matched to its DXF entity by layer and position; a rewritten text is stamped forsk:label_source=dxf and forsk:dxf_handle.
